manifest.name: ud-downs-q4k-gdn-qkv-q4k-lmhead-embed-q4k
manifest.description: #126 (unsloth UD-Q4_K_M with routed expert downs, lm_head and token embeddings on Q4_K: RP-KL 0.0493, decode 403.1, 23.96 GiB) with the recurrent qkv projections of the 30 Gated DeltaNet layers on Q4_K (kq_rtn) instead of unsloth's Q8_0. They are the largest dense tensors a decoded token reads in full (0.50 B weights), and Q4_K is the format SparkInfer reads fastest, so decode rises by about 7% with 0.23 GiB less memory; attention, the recurrent z/out and the shared experts stay Q8_0. Measured on an RTX 5090 against #126 built the same way: RP-KL +0.012, decode 403.4 -> 431.3, peak 23.96 -> 23.73 GiB.
